description.value: Muddy Waters Café is a family-owned cafe, espresso bar, and ice cream shop that has operated in Harrison Hot Springs since 1993, located across from the beach with mountain views. The menu is built around farm-to-table principles, with ingredients sourced from farms in the surrounding Fraser Valley region and home-baked goods made on premises. Staff are mostly local and can point touring cyclists toward the lake, hiking trails, and the famous hot springs.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and confirms this is a family-owned cafe/espresso bar/ice cream shop in Harrison Hot Springs (not Chilliwack as OSM's community field suggests), operating since 1993 with farm-to-table food. The menu shows multiple vegetarian items (Black bean Garden Burger, Baby Mozzarella, Mediterranean Yogurt, Brie with Sliced Pear).
